spans.s:
Paṭharvan appears to be the name of a man in the Rigveda.^1
According to Ludwig,^2 however, the word is Paṭharu, and is
the name of a fort which was saved by a rain-storm from
being set on fire.
1) i. 112, 17, with Sāyaṇa's note.
2) Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 204.
Cf. Griffith, Hymns of the Rigveda, 1,
147, 148.
